cross-reference.answer: I read §2002:9.2.7. The sentence 'For a monochrome terminal, the color attributes are mapped onto other attributes by the implementor' and the color numbers 0-7 are the same as 2023's. The diff shows only table layout and 'may' against 'can' in the NOTE, so the scope is unchanged. The screen facility is declined at --std 2002 under §2002:B.3 item 1 with §2002:3.1.5 (the reader's licence-2002), so nothing a 2002 program can show changes.
